name: Gästehaus Bichler
beschreibung:
Quietly and sunnily situated on the edge of Soell, Gaestehaus Bichler is an inviting family-run haven. Cosy rooms provide peaceful rest after active days exploring the alpine scenery.

The Soell cable car connecting into SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental and mountain trails are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Bichler in Soell offers warm Tyrolean hospitality at the base of the Wilder Kaiser.
